title.en: An Act Converting the Panique High School in Barangay Panique, Municipality of Aroroy, Province of Masbate to a National High School to Be Known as the Panique National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Panique High School in Barangay Panique, Municipality of Aroroy, Province of Masbate to a National High School to Be Known as the Panique National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Panique thành Trường Trung học Panique Quốc gia tại Barangay Panique, Đô thị Aroroy, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Panique เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Panique แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Panique เทศบาล Aroroy และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Panique menjadi Sekolah Menengah Panique Nasional di Barangay Panique, Kotamadya Aroroy, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Panique kepada Sekolah Menengah Panique Kebangsaan di Barangay Panique, Perbandaran Aroroy, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Panique High School in Barangay Panique, Municipality of Aroroy, Province of Masbate shall be converted into a national high school to be known as the Panique National High School.
The Panique National High School shall be under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS).
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
